posts.text:
Disagree. 

Texas has as much money to spend as any team. Not a Cinderella.


Sam Block (@theblockspot)

Texas is an 11-seed.
Texas went 9-9 in the SEC.
Texas played in the First Four.

School size means nothing.
Texas is absolutely a real Cinderella.



— https://nitter.net/theblockspot/status/2035525538010345839#m
Breaking: With Renee Montgomery out sick tomorrow,  CBS plans to showcase Jasmine Crockett for its NCAA studio show on Sunday, per sources.
Lakers are a fun story. Great win.

Let me admit it. 

I miss Bruce Pearl.  Seriously. I miss Bruce Pearl on the studio show.
That's a really hard slap on the MSU players' hand. Brutal.  Kholer may never recover from that stinging feeling. Reminds me of Jack Tatum and Daryl Stingley.

Look, I think what Indiana did is great. Best-coached team in college football. NIL and the transfer portal made it possible. Everything in college sports is a pay-for-play story at this point.


🌰Buckeye Sloopy (@419_sloopy)

Jason, who did they outspend? Miami, Bama, Oregon, Ohio State easily outspent them. 

How was it pay for play?



— https://nitter.net/419_sloopy/status/2035369174722044268#m
These coaches are clever pawning these interviews off on their players.

Is Taylor Sheridan the ChatGPT of TV shows?

One person cannot write every show on every network. Sheridan is a brand that's suppose to signal the show is slightly less woke than what you're used to.

True.


RP McMurphy (@WellOverTheNest)

You are just angry because Charles Barkley is losing weight at a higher rate than you



— https://nitter.net/WellOverTheNest/status/2035406129375645717#m

Good lord. 

CBS pushes out James Brown the same year NBC pushed out Tony Dungy. 

Wow. 

The secular agenda never stops.


Ryan Glasspiegel (@sportsrapport)

Have seen a few people asking why Nate Burleson is CBS March Madness studio host.

Ernie Johnson asked to step back from some of the dates in the role. 

CBS is testing to see if Burleson could eventually replace James Brown as NFL Today host.



— https://nitter.net/sportsrapport/status/2035408307825869138#m

Why is a former NFL player the host? She's terrible, but she's more qualified to be there than Nate Burleson.


FightTheGoodFight (@YouWontCancelMe)

What is the need to insert a WNBA player into the mix?   Has there been some huge outcry for a female studio voice during March Madness that I missed?  Bring back the old white male coaches...



— https://nitter.net/YouWontCancelMe/status/2035405491656860104#m

This CBS studio show is why I say capitalism is dead.  

Capitalism = the customer is always right. 

Equity = the agenda is always right.

This CBS studio show is absolutely embarrassing. Zero concern for the audience. An inconsequential NFL player, a really inconsequential WNBA player, an all-time great NBA player who doesn't follow college basketball, and Clark Kellogg.  Wow.  The agenda is just too much.

This hits different coming from Glenn. 

Truth-teller.


Glenn Greenwald (@ggreenwald)

Mossad scientists created the purest caricature of a flamboyant black gay culture TikTok influencer, then implanted him with an AI chip to spew the most sociopathic Israeli scripts of mass slaughter, fused with Ben-Gvir's id.  

 This type of human experimentation should banned.



— https://nitter.net/ggreenwald/status/2035358612542181453#m

Again, I love Indiana football and Curt Cignetti. But Indiana football isn't a Cinderella story. It's a pay-for-play story.


Toby T (@Tobizoid)

Transfer portal and NIL transformed nobody’s like Indiana and Texas Tech in football into powers in 2-3 years.



— https://nitter.net/Tobizoid/status/2035333417068367880#m

I love the Indiana football story. But Indiana is a P4 with lots of money. You've been programmed to ignore  that the elite in sports and the real world are making things harder on the little guy. Indiana State and Larry Bird > Indiana University and Curt Cignetti.


Stephen Streaker (@StephenStreaker)

Everyone blames NIL and transfer portal but it gave us the National  championship Hoosiers.



— https://nitter.net/StephenStreaker/status/2035313384694915500#m

Boom.


Jeff Goodman (@GoodmanHoops)

Favorites went 16-0 yesterday.

This year's first round had 13 of 32 games decided by 20+ points.

High Point only true mid-major still alive, and its NIL is probably most of any team in 1-bid league.

I hate to admit it, but due to NIL & transfer portal, Cinderellas may be dead.



— https://nitter.net/GoodmanHoops/status/2035324338463727980#m

Same thing is happening to the men's tournament. Transfer portal and NIL feed the rich and starve the poor.  Equity.


StaceyDales (@StaceyDales)

The first round of the women’s NCAA tournament is usually what turns people off. It’s not competitive. And the top teams feel it too. Much respect to the lower seeds.♥️



— https://nitter.net/StaceyDales/status/2035127407569412333#m

It's sad.


Jim Root (@2ndChancePoints)

CBS just openly mocking college hoops fans by making a game of how little their studio crew knows/cares about college hoops



— https://nitter.net/2ndChancePoints/status/2035042486050332960#m
